# NutriFit® MCP Plugin for Antigravity

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Streamable%20HTTP-brightgreen.svg)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io)
[![Antigravity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-orange.svg)](https://antigravity.google)
[![Entity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Company-NutriFit%20LLC%20(Wyoming%2C%20USA)-informational.svg)](https://nutrifit.health)

---

---

Official plugin by **NutriFit LLC** (Wyoming, USA) for **Google Antigravity**. Empowers AI agents with secure, comprehensive access to personal nutrition tracking, macro balancing, physical workouts, blood biomarkers, and supplement routines via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

---

## 🌟 Key Features

* 🥗 **Smart Meal & Food Logging:** Accurate food recognition, portion analysis, calorie counting, macronutrient breakdown (proteins, fats, carbohydrates), dietary fiber, and glycemic load calculation powered by NutriFit®.
* 📊 **Nutritional Analytics:** In-depth daily and weekly macro/micronutrient summaries benchmarked against individual wellness targets.
* 🏋️ **Workout & Activity Journal:** Complete exercise tracking, sport catalog lookup, and precise energy expenditure estimation.
* 🩸 **Biomarkers & Health Metrics:** Longitudinal tracking of laboratory test results (lipid profile, fasting glucose, ferritin, vitamins) and body composition metrics.
* 💊 **Supplement Schedule:** Intake logging, vitamin schedules, inventory reminders, and evidence-based recommendations.

---

## 📦 Installation in Antigravity

### Method 1: Marketplace (One-Click)
Find **NutriFit® MCP** in the Antigravity Extensions Marketplace (**Settings → Customizations → Marketplace**) or paste this card directly in chat:

```markdown
<plugin-card catalog-id="nutrifit-health/nutrifit-mcp"></plugin-card>
```

### Method 2: Manual Installation
Clone this repository directly into your local customizations directory:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nutrifit-health/nutrifit-mcp.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/nutrifit-mcp
```

The plugin will be automatically discovered by Antigravity upon application startup.

---

## 🔒 Security & Architecture

* **Streamable HTTP:** The plugin connects directly to the production cloud endpoint `https://mcp.nutrifit.health/mcp`.
* **Zero Backend Exposure:** Proprietary business logic, algorithms, and backend databases remain isolated on secure NutriFit LLC infrastructure. The plugin functions purely as a declarative connector.
* **Authentication:** Access to sensitive personal health records is safeguarded by NutriFit® OAuth and Bearer token authentication.

---
